description.en: A source-verified MiniMax H3 product commercial prompt with attached video evidence from @ShamsAmin56.
description.zh: 由原作者公开 X 帖提供并已核验视频结果的 MiniMax H3产品广告提示词。

prompt:
Claude

Interactive Game Equipment UI (15s)

Use Image 1 as a STRICT CHARACTER REFERENCE. Preserve the character exactly: oversized yellow hooded jacket, glossy black faceless helmet, black armored tactical torso, tattooed left arm, glossy red tactical cargo pants with hanging straps and pouches, black combat boots, and the massive crimson-black biomechanical right arm with organic tendrils and clawed fingers. Do not alter colors, proportions, outfit, or mechanical design.
0–2 Seconds

High-angle overhead cinematic shot. The character sits on a vivid, highly saturated purple floor with one knee raised and the enormous crimson biomechanical arm resting beside him. He slowly tilts his head upward toward the camera. A premium AAA futuristic game interface fades in.

Top left:
 Player Profile
 REAPER
 Level 42
Right side menu:
START NEW GAME
CONTINUE (highlighted)

LOADOUT

SETTINGS
EXIT GAME
A sleek white cursor smoothly clicks CONTINUE.
2–4 Seconds
Camera pushes in toward the biomechanical right arm.

A translucent RIGHT ARM EQUIPMENT panel slides in.

Equipment list:

PHANTOM GRIP
ABYSS CLAW
HELLFORGE TALON

CRIMSON REAVER
The selector moves to ABYSS CLAW.
The right arm begins transforming.
Red-black armor plates separate.

Organic crimson tendrils weave together.

Mechanical pistons rotate.

Claw fingers extend into longer razor blades.

Internal red energy pulses through exposed cables.

Small particles and sparks emit as the transformation locks into place.

4–7 Seconds

Camera smoothly arcs around the character's right side.

A large ARMAMENT CUSTOMIZATION interface appears.

Component grid:

Shoulder

Upper Arm

Elbow

Forearm
Wrist
Claw System
Core Reactor
Tendril Matrix
Selections cycle rapidly.
The biomechanical arm partially disassembles.
Armor segments detach.

Internal skeletal frame becomes visible.

Hydraulic pistons rotate.

Mechanical tendrils retract and regrow.

New crimson armor slides into place.

Claw geometry reshapes into a more aggressive configuration before locking with a satisfying mechanical snap.

7–8.5 Seconds

Camera pulls back to a medium shot.

A large glowing CONFIRM CONFIGURATION button appears.

Cursor clicks.

Every interface panel folds inward using holographic animations and disappears.

The character rises from the seated position.

He slowly flexes the upgraded biomechanical arm.

The massive claws open and close once.

Crimson energy briefly surges through the entire limb.

8.5–10 Seconds

A cinematic LOADING bar appears across the bottom.

Progress accelerates from 0% → 100%.

The purple environment gradually fades into darkness.

Golden light leaks through the scene.

Subtle volumetric fog forms.

Ambient audio transitions from UI sounds to a living city.

10–15 Seconds

The world fully loads.

The character now stands inside a dense cyberpunk megacity.

Rain-soaked streets.

Neon holographic advertisements.

Steam rising from vents.

Moving crowds.

Hover drones patrol overhead.

Motorcycles race past.

Towering futuristic skyscrapers loom in the distance.

Camera settles into a polished third-person gameplay perspective behind the character.

HUD fades in:

Minimap (top right)

Health & Energy (bottom left)

Ability Icons

Weapon Indicator
Objective Marker
The character activates the crimson biomechanical arm, flexes the claws once, then confidently walks into the neon-lit street as the mission begins.
Style: AAA Unreal Engine 5 cinematic, photorealistic PBR materials, production-quality game UI, premium sci-fi HUD, seamless mechanical transformation, cinematic camera motion, ray-traced lighting, volumetric fog, rain reflections, 4K, 60fps, no glitches, no UI clipping, no extra limbs, perfect character consistency, movie-grade color grading.
